$Comment: Beat the Great Turkey on the Turkey Graveyard's hard way in
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.json), which Martha opens once a player
has finished her quest The Great Turkey. ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names the hard fight's encounter script
never the creature, and every player the fight credits earns it at once, however many shared the win.
The criterion's TextKey words the step.
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table tag. The Full Table asks only for
what one player can do alone in one feast, and the hard way in is a fight for a party, so it stays off
that list, and every yearly Harvest Feast achievement must be on it. It pays Harvest Coins, a Wishbone
for another run, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Defense XP for the fight, all waiting on the
achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the
hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest
still pays. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_great_turkey_hard_down, and its words
come from the keys that id spells.
